::: {.patient-banner}
## Additional Acute Care Skills

Today’s session is a skills-based workshop focused on oral mechanism assessment, cranial nerve function, dysphagia treatment, instrumental assessment, and clinical reasoning in acute care.
:::

::: {.warning}
## SLP Task

Work through each module with your group. Be prepared to explain your clinical reasoning, demonstrate components of an oral mechanism examination, and justify when instrumentation may be indicated.
:::

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this session, students will be able to:

- Perform a focused oral mechanism examination.
- Identify cranial nerves relevant to swallowing, speech, and airway protection.
- Connect oral mechanism findings to possible functional impairments.
- Differentiate compensatory and rehabilitative dysphagia interventions.
- Summarize current evidence regarding dysphagia treatment in acute and critical care.
- Compare the purposes and limitations of bedside assessment, FEES, and MBSS.
- Select an appropriate assessment approach based on the clinical question.
- Participate in a guided FEES demonstration.

---

## Today’s Modules

### 1. Cranial Nerves and Oral Mechanism Examination

Review the cranial nerves most relevant to speech and swallowing, then quiz yourself using hidden-answer activities.

[Begin Cranial Nerve Review](cranial-nerves.html)

### 2. Evidence-Based Dysphagia Treatment

Review treatment categories and findings from a systematic review of dysphagia interventions in acute and critical care.

[Review Dysphagia Treatment](dysphagia-treatment.html)

### 3. Oral Mechanism Case Practice

Apply your oral mechanism examination skills to four brief acute care cases.

[Begin Case Practice](case-practice.html)

### 4. Bedside Assessment and Instrumentation

Compare the clinical swallow evaluation, FEES, and MBSS and determine which approach best answers the clinical question.

[Compare Assessment Options](instrumentation.html)

### 5. FEES Demonstration

Prepare for today’s guided FEES demonstration.

[Prepare for the FEES Demo](fees-demo.html)

### 6. Additional Resources

Review the assigned articles and additional learning resources.

[View Resources](resources.html)
